controls.name: C-21d
controls.query:
FROM logs-postgresql.log-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= "2026-07-06T20:02:30.000Z" AND @timestamp < "2026-07-06T21:02:30.000Z"
        AND host.name == "db-1"
| STATS cnt = COUNT(*),
        first_seen = MIN(@timestamp),
        last_seen = MAX(@timestamp)
        BY message, user.name
| SORT cnt DESC
| LIMIT 30
